title: :emoji: When "It'll Probably Be Fine" ... Isn't
content:
Yep, things really do work in that bizarre, "surely this can't be real?" kind of way. That's what the original Mefite, mathowie, discovered while digging into the minutiae of homeowner's insurance and natural-disaster prep.

Bottom line, you're probably not as covered as you think. So take this as a friendly nudge to double and triple-check every clause in your policy before anything goes sideways.
author: Brandon Blatcher
